thing.text:
MAKING A SOUND

A sound starts silent -- a
flat line on its screen.

Drop the [frequency,
seconds, shape] box on one
and it sings: the number is
hertz, the fraction is how
long, the pad is which of
the four waveshapes.

The waveform on the screen
is what it will sound like.

TO TRY IT

Press SPACE with a sound in
your hand, or under the
pointer, to play it; "." to
stop it.

Drop the box on the silent
speaker. Then pick the box
up again, type a different
number on its frequency,
swap a shape pad into its
third hole, and drop it on
the next one.

Every sound here was made
exactly this way.

THE FOUR SHAPES

Same pitch, same length --
four different instruments.
A sine is a whistle, a
square a game console, a
sawtooth a brass section, a
triangle something between
a flute and a bell.

Anything else in that hole
is read as "sine".
